_comment: Checked-in fallback license text for packages generate-third-party-licenses.mjs cannot attribute from an installed LICENSE file or a substantive README '# License' section. Keyed 'name@version'; each value needs 'holder' (copyright holder, rendered as 'Copyright (c) <holder>'), 'license' (SPDX-ish identifier, informational), and 'text' (the license body, without a leading copyright line -- the generator prepends one from 'holder'). Add an entry here only after confirming upstream really ships no LICENSE file for that exact version, and cite where the text came from in a sibling '<key>_source' comment.
react-remove-scroll-bar@2.3.8_source: Fetched from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theKashey/react-remove-scroll-bar/master/LICENSE on 2026-09-02. The published npm package (react-remove-scroll-bar@2.3.8) ships only dist/ and constants/ (see its package.json 'files') -- no LICENSE file -- and its README's '# License' section is just the word 'MIT', not the permission text MIT distribution requires. No v2.3.8 git tag exists upstream to pin the fetch to; the repository's current (unversioned) LICENSE file's body has not changed across releases.
